subject: prequran
title: The Arabic Alphabet
summary: Meet all 29 Arabic letters: how each one looks, sounds, and is made — with a familiar animal sound bridge and a first Arabic word for every letter.

provenance.source: Quraan Academy legacy alphabet unit (content only; fresh build 2026-07)

letters.name: alif
letters.articulation: Alif / hamzah starts from the deepest throat; stop the airflow gently, then release the sound.

transliteration.explainer: You heard the Arabic sound alif. In English letters we write it as a — like the a in Alligator. The English letters are only helpers — the real sound is the one you heard.

word.explainer: This word is asad. It means lion, and it begins with the letter alif. Try saying it with me: asad.

writing.explainer: To write alif, remember that Arabic is written from right to left, so we start on the right side. Watch the pen in the video from the very start to the very end, then trace alif in the air with your finger.
